notes: A079128_coprime: gcd(a(n), n) = 1 for n >= 1, a(n) = Nat.card of permutations of Fin n whose cycle lengths (minimal periods) have gcd 1. Key: for p | n, n = pm, the p-group (Z/p)^m of block shifts acts by conjugation; fixed points are the shifts with some zero block, p^m - (p-1)^m = (-1)^(m+1) mod p (Mathlib IsPGroup.card_modEq_card_fixedPoints). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.

sources.cite: A. Kallat, A p-adic Valuation Calculus for Permutations with Restricted Cycle Lengths, arXiv:2610.40342 (2026), Cor. 6.2

prior_art.note: Known since Oct 2026 (paper); first Lean proof, by a different p-group argument.
